## Workload

Marcus Bell recorded 373 reads during 495 hours of grading. This equates to 0.8 per hour. The workload review considered both the recorded activity and the time available for grading. The figures provide a clear summary of the work completed during the review period and support continued monitoring of throughput.

## Quality

A total of 27 items were checked as part of the quality review. The recorded agreement was 70.4. The grader and reviewer agreed to retain the current session pattern while continuing to monitor quality and workload together.
